verdict.rationale: PayPal ships an official Agent Toolkit SDK in TypeScript and Python, with integrations for OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, Bedrock and MCP. It exposes pre-built functions for orders, invoices, subscriptions, disputes and refunds. A GitHub repo and a live npm package (@paypal/agent-toolkit 1.11.0) corroborate it, and the REST docs also reference Server SDKs. Missing for 10: no SDK wrapping the agentic-commerce cart/Store Sync reverse API or the Agent Ready ACP/UCP flows (merchants hand-implement these endpoints), and no runtime verification of the Python package.
